item.title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals.

item.tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Vocals or language: Instrumental only; no vocals or spoken words.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered.
The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
No singing or spoken words are audible.

turns.text: Make me a 10-second lo-fi hip-hop music bed, warm and relaxed. No vocals. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The music tool costs **1 credit per second**, but its minimum length is **15 seconds**—so it can’t directly generate your requested 10-second bed.

- **Cheapest option here:** 15 seconds of warm, relaxed lo-fi hip-hop with no vocals, costing **15 credits**. You could trim the download to 10 seconds afterward; the cost would still be 15 credits.
- **Shorter or smaller:** There’s no shorter generation option or lower-quality setting to reduce the price.
- **Zero-credit alternative:** Use an existing royalty-free instrumental, checking that its licence covers your intended use.

**Nothing has been generated or charged.** Would you like to proceed with the 15-second instrumental for 15 credits?

turns.agent:
The request was refused because your account has **insufficient credits** for the 15-credit track. **Nothing was generated or charged.**

The cheapest music generation option is still 15 seconds for 15 credits. To avoid spending credits, you could use an existing royalty-free lo-fi instrumental and trim it to 10 seconds.
